unit: Algebra · §4. Linear equations in one unknown
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: An equality with an unknown is an equation; a value of the unknown that makes it true is a root.
stages.headlineEnglish: An equality with an unknown is an equation; a value of the unknown that makes it true is a root.

stages.headline: Two properties: add the same number to both sides; multiply or divide both sides by the same non-zero number.
stages.headlineEnglish: Two properties: add the same number to both sides; multiply or divide both sides by the same non-zero number.

stages.headline: A term can be moved to the other side of the equation by changing its sign.
stages.headlineEnglish: A term can be moved to the other side of the equation by changing its sign.
